_comment: Anonymized example. Copy this file to qa/local.llm.local.json and fill in your own values; the real file is git-ignored (qa/*.local.json). AUTO/LOCAL may also discover the launcher on this machine and create the ignored local file themselves once the local model answers; the values below stay placeholders. Nothing here is a secret, and the real path/command must never be committed.
launch_command: <command that starts your loopback OpenAI-compatible server>
launch_cwd: <optional working directory of the launch command>
